inflation_cpi.note: September 2026 point to point (BBS); food 7.22%, non-food 9.30%.

inflation_projection.note: CPI has run at 8-10% for three years and Bangladesh Bank's 5-6% goal is not yet credible, so we plan with 8%, the current rate rounded down.

policy_rate.note: Repo rate held at 9.50% in the Oct-Dec 2026 quarterly statement (SLF 11.00%, SDF 7.50%).

savings_account_rate.sourceName: Bangladesh Bank, scheduled banks' announced deposit rates
savings_account_rate.note: October 2026 chart, savings deposits under Tk 1 crore: median about 3.25% across scheduled banks, most between 2.5% and 4.5%.

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: Bangladesh Bank, scheduled banks' announced deposit rates
fdr_3m_rate.note: October 2026 chart, fixed deposits of 3 to under 6 months: median about 7.4% across scheduled banks, most between 7% and 9%.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: Bangladesh Bank, scheduled banks' announced deposit rates
fdr_1y_rate.note: October 2026 chart, fixed deposits of 1 to under 2 years: median about 8.25% across scheduled banks, most between 7% and 10%.

dps_rate.note: Bangladesh Bank's deposit-rate chart has no DPS column; the only DPS rates found were individual banks' own rate sheets (about 8.25%-10.5% for 5 years), which cannot be cited.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: 5-year Bangladesh Sanchayapatra, Jul-Dec 2026, holdings up to the tier cap; 11.80% above it.

tbill_91d_rate.note: Auction cut-off 8.56% on 26 Oct 2026; the next auction (2 Nov 2026) cut off at 8.37%.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Tax Summaries, Bangladesh withholding taxes
tax_bank_interest.note: 10% on interest from savings and fixed deposits for individuals; 15% (50% more) when the payee cannot show proof of return submission. Secondary source; last reviewed 31 Jul 2026.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: Deposit Protection Bill 2026, passed 10 Apr 2026, raised cover from Tk 100,000 to Tk 200,000 per depositor; the limit is reviewed every three years.

equity_return_low.note: DSEX rose only about 1.5% a year (price only) over the last 10 years.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSEX); Sanchayapatra and T-bill after tax
equity_return_base.note: Weak 10-year DSEX record, so the base is kept below the 10.6% after-tax Sanchayapatra rate and within 4 points of the 7.7% after-tax 91-day T-bill.

equity_return_high.note: A recovery case with dividends and earnings growth near nominal GDP growth.

gold_return_low.sourceName: BAJUS gold prices via Financial Express
gold_return_low.note: Gold can stall in taka terms for years when dollar gold falls and the taka is stable.

gold_return_base.sourceName: BAJUS gold prices via Financial Express
gold_return_base.note: Dollar gold trend plus expected taka depreciation, set equal to the 8% inflation assumption.

gold_return_high.sourceName: BAJUS gold prices via Financial Express
gold_return_high.note: Strong dollar gold plus faster taka depreciation, as in 2022-2024.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Bangladesh Bank deposit-rate chart; 10% tax on interest
fixed_income_return_low.note: 1-year fixed deposit about 8.25% less 10% tax is 7.4%; the low case allows for rate cuts.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Sanchayapatra, DPS and T-bill rates after tax
fixed_income_return_base.note: Blend of 1-year fixed deposits (7.4% after tax), 91-day T-bills (7.7%) and 5-year Sanchayapatra (10.6%) after tax.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: 57% of claims settled as of June 2026 (IDRA target 75%), amid a Tk 70 bn backlog of unpaid life claims; the article may mean the whole sector rather than life only.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published pure-term premium tables found; one 2025 worked example (age 35, non-smoker, 20-year term) gives about Tk 3.9 per Tk 1,000 of cover (insurancenews24.com). The rates seed carries a placeholder table.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No typical cost of one major private hospital stay published; HIES 2022 analysis gives a yearly average out-of-pocket hospitalisation cost of USD 538 in private facilities (BMC Cost Effectiveness and Resource Allocation, 2025), which is not a major-stay figure. The rates seed carries a placeholder.

health_premium_table.note: No published individual health insurance premium tables found; standalone health cover is sold only by non-life insurers and is thin. The rates seed carries a placeholder table.

goal_inflation_health.note: No medical CPI series is published; we plan with 10%, about 2 points above general inflation.

goal_inflation_education.note: No education CPI series is published; we plan with 10%, about 2 points above general inflation.

life_expectancy.note: BBS Sample Vital Statistics 2023 (published Mar 2024; older than 2025, latest BBS figure found); men 70.8, women 73.8. UN WPP/World Bank give 74.9 for 2024.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: BBS SVRS 2020 life table; UN WPP 2026 projection
life_table_remaining.note: Explainer only; never the plan-to age. total/men/women are the BBS SVRS 2020 life table carried over from the rates seed (older than 2025; not re-verified); projected values are UN WPP 2026 as shown on georank.org (expected age at death minus current age).

support_ratio.note: People aged 15-64 per person 65+, computed from the UN WPP 2024 age structure; World Bank old-age dependency 10.15 (2025) gives 9.9.

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Bangladesh Labour Act 2006, s.28 (official English text, Ministry of Law)
retirement_age_default.note: Workers retire on completing 60 years of age; law in force as amended.

retirement_age_government.note: Public Servants (Retirement) Act 1974, raised from 57 to 59 in 2011. Source article is from 2024 (older than 2025); no later change found.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Bangladesh Bank deposit-rate chart; 10% tax on interest
retirement_return_low.note: 1-year fixed deposit about 8.25% less 10% tax is 7.4%, rounded down for possible rate cuts.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: Bangladesh Bank T-bill auctions; 10% withholding on securities interest
retirement_return_base.note: 91-day T-bill 8.56% less the 10% withholding on securities interest is 7.7%, so the base is held at 7.5%; the rates seed uses 10% based on Sanchayapatra.

retirement_return_high.note: A retiree holding Pensioner or 5-year Sanchayapatra within the caps earns about 10.6% after tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Mostly fixed income with weak equity.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Balanced mix of fixed deposits, T-bills and Sanchayapatra (about 8.5% after tax), equity (9%) and gold (8%).

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: Equity recovery and full use of Sanchayapatra caps.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Raised by Tk 50 to Tk 700 a month in the FY2026-27 budget (from July 2026), for 6.2 million recipients; means-tested; never counted in the plan.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: The rates seed gives men 65, women 62, means-tested, Tk 1,000 over age 90, citing only a district office home page; dss.gov.bd failed TLS checks and no page confirming these rules could be read.

gratuity_rule.sourceName: Bangladesh Labour Act 2006, s.2(10) (official English text, Ministry of Law)
gratuity_rule.note: At least 30 days' last wages per completed year of service, or 45 days per year for service over 10 years (clause substituted in 2013); law in force.

public_pension_scheme.note: No guaranteed rate; fixed amount for life. The official brief says the nominee receives the pension until the member would have turned 75 (the seed had 80). Entry 18-50 pays until 60; over 50 pays 10 years. Projections are from Prothom Alo, Sep 2026 (not re-verified).

equity_fund.note: Diversified open-end funds only; no index funds or ETFs trade in Bangladesh.

gold.note: Bought as jewellery or bars; priced per bhori by BAJUS.

insuranceComplaints.name: Insurance Development and Regulatory Authority (complaints)
insuranceComplaints.note: Complaints about insurers go to IDRA.

publicHealthCover.name: Directorate General of Health Services (public hospitals)
publicHealthCover.note: No national health insurance; public hospitals charge low fees.
